ch15-viewing-childs-information.en: Let's see how to view your child's information.
After you sign in, the dashboard shows a card for each of your children, with a quick summary.
Click Overview on the card to open the full page for that child.
The top shows the photo, class and roll number. The cards below show attendance, fees due, the last exam and days present.
Under Details, choose a page, for example Exam Results, to see marks and grades.
ch16-ai-study-helper.en: Click AI Study Helper in the sidebar. It is a tutor that knows your class and subjects.
Click one of the suggestions to ask it right away.
Or type your own question in the box and press Enter. Shift and Enter start a new line.
You can send up to 30 messages a day. Your chat is saved, so you can come back to it later.
Click Clear Chat to delete the conversation and start again.
ch16-my-assignments.en: Click Assignments in the sidebar to see work from all your teachers.
Each card shows the subject, type, due date and status. Graded work shows your marks and the teacher's feedback.
A Diary Entry is for reading only, so it has no Submit button.
For an open assignment, press Submit.
Type your answer. Submission Text is required. A link to your file is optional.
Press Submit Assignment. A green message confirms it, and the card now shows Submitted.
ch16-my-results.en: Click Results in the sidebar. Each published exam is a card with your total, percentage and grade.
Under each exam you see marks, percentage and a Pass or Fail badge for every subject.
Click an exam title to show only that exam. A paper you missed shows as Absent.
ch17-gate-passes.en: Let's create and manage a gate pass.
Open Hostel and Gate Passes, then press New Gate Pass.
Choose the student and the pass type, then enter the reason and where the student is going.
The leaving time and the expected return are already filled in. Change them if the student leaves at a different time.
Press Create Gate Pass. It starts as Pending Approval.
Press Approve, add a remark if you like, and confirm.
When the student leaves the gate, press Check Out.
When the student is back, press Mark Returned, and the pass is complete.
ch17-managing-hostels-rooms.en: Let's set up hostels and rooms.
Open Hostel and Rooms, then press Add Hostel.
Enter the hostel name, choose Boys, Girls or Mixed, and set the capacity and a warden.
Press Add Hostel, and the hostel appears in the list.
Open the Rooms tab and choose the hostel.
Press Add Room. Enter the room number, the floor and the capacity, and choose the room type.
Press Add Room again. The room shows its capacity and how many beds are taken.
ch17-student-allocations.en: Let's allocate students to hostel beds.
Open Hostel and Allocations. The students who hold a bed are listed.
Press Allocate Student. Choose the student, the hostel and a room that has a free bed.
Press Allocate, and the student appears in the list with the room.
To free a bed, press Vacate on the student and confirm.
Choose Vacated in the status filter to see students who left, with the date.
ch19-creating-student-user-accounts.en: Let's create a student account with a login.
Choose the class and enter the student's name and the parent details. The roll number is suggested for you.
At the bottom, tick Create User Account. The username is suggested from the name.
Enter a password of at least eight characters and confirm it. The email is optional.
Press Add Student. The student and login are created together, so the student can sign in to the Student Portal.
ch19-managing-users-school-admin-princip: Let's manage the users of your school.
Open Settings in the sidebar and click the Users tab. It lists every user of your school.
Press Add User to open the form.
Enter the name, a username, an email and a password, then choose the role. The list only offers roles you are allowed to create.
Press Create User. A green message confirms it, and the user can log in straight away.
Search by name, username or email, or filter by role, to find the user in the list.
Click Edit to change the name, email, role or phone. The username cannot be changed.
If someone forgets their password, click Reset Password. Set a new password now, or email them a reset link when they have an email address.
Click Deactivate, and the user can no longer log in.
Click Activate to give the access back.
ch21-items-stock.en: Let's manage your items and stock.
Open Inventory in the sidebar and choose Items. Each item shows its stock, price and a status.
Open Categories and add one. Vendors work the same way.
Press Add Item. Enter the name, choose the category and unit, and set the current stock, the minimum stock and the price.
Press Create, and the item appears in the list.
Use Stock Status to see only Low Stock or Out of Stock items, so you know what to reorder.
Press AI Suggest and choose a kind of school, such as Science Lab. Tick the items you want and add them in one go.
ch21-item-assignments.en: Open Inventory in the sidebar and choose Assignments. It shows who currently holds which item.
Choose the item, the person and the quantity. Add a note, such as a serial number or the purpose.
Press Assign. The item is dated today, and its stock goes down.
When an item comes back, press Return on its row, choose its condition and confirm. The stock is restored.
Open the Returned tab to see items that came back, with the date and condition. You can also search by person or item.
ch21-stock-transactions.en: Open Inventory in the sidebar and choose Transactions. Every stock movement is listed here with its date, type and quantity.
Choose Purchase, then the item. The unit price is filled in for you. Enter the quantity, choose the vendor and add the invoice number.
Press Record Transaction. The purchase appears in the list, and the stock of the item goes up.
For damaged or expired items choose Disposal and enter a positive quantity. The stock goes down by that amount. An Adjustment corrects a count, and takes a negative number to reduce stock.
Use Type and the From and To dates to narrow the history. Here only disposals are shown.
mark-attendance.en: First, open Attendance and choose Manual Entry.
Pick your class and confirm today's date.
The student list appears. Tap Mark All Present to start from a clean slate.
Now change only the exceptions. Mark one student absent, and another on leave.
The counts at the top update as you go.
Finally, press Save Attendance. A confirmation shows how many records were saved.
